data.content: Rainy Sunday. Takeshi wants to take Rin fishing; Rin is mid-raid.

Rain's coming down steady, Rin. Best kind of weather — fish bite like they're mad at somebody.

Gear's already in the truck. You can finish that raid when the tide's out.

dad, i'm mid-pull. the tide'll still be out in twenty, the fish can hate me later.

besides, it's raining. i'd rather tank drowned gods than sit in a wet boat.

Twenty minutes. I'll hold the boat like a good brakeman holds a platform.

But mark my words, the big one's on a schedule, and so am I. Rain's just water with ambition.

you're really gonna compare a boat to a train platform. okay, station master.

nineteen minutes. then i'm legally yours.
The rain suddenly stops and the sun comes out.

Hah. Sky heard me and pulled the brake. Sun's out — tell your raid the weather changed without a permit.

Eighteen minutes, station master's counting. I'll go check the worms. Rain or shine, that's the deal I made with the fish.

sun's out and you're still on the worms. dedication. hope the fish know what they're signing up for.

seventeen. if the pug wipes again i'm farming this without you, old man.

Old man still out-fishes a pug every Sunday, and you know it. That's not trash talk, that's just my catch log.

Seventeen minutes, then I unplug the router myself. Kidding. Partly.

a catch log is just a spreadsheet with feelings. i've seen your spreadsheets.

hit him back. the router threat's real and we both know it.

A spreadsheet with feelings. That's the girl who named her guild after a steam engine, so I'll take it.

Fine, I'll skip the router. But the coffee's poured and there's one bucket hat left on the peg. Rain's gone, fish don't take excuses.

you leave the steam engine out of this. she was a good boiler.

raid's done. someone died to the last add because of course they did. ten minutes to wrangle my hoodie and i'm in the truck.
